Can you provide the CSV and the assurance doc by EOD next Tuesday (Dec 8)? Also flag any planned changes in the next 90 days that could impact subprocessor location or cloud provider.

Feel free to loop in your security lead. I copied procurement for scheduling.

Hi Samantha —

Quick answers inline below. Happy to expand in a call if helpful.

1) DataLakeOps: access scope and controls- DataLakeOps is a managed retention&ingestion subprocessor used for long-term analytics processing. They do NOT receive raw customer prompts by default. Access is scoped to pseudonymized blobs and aggregated telemetry; raw prompt data is only forwarded under explicit customer opt-in for diagnostic retention. When raw data is ingested (opt-in), it is encrypted at rest using customer-specific KMS keys and access is limited to a small number of authorized engineers under MFA and JIT (just-in-time) privileged access. We can produce a one-page data flow diagram under NDA.

2) SOC 2 contact and bridge letter- Please send the NDA to legal@redwoodinference.com; our Security Compliance lead (John Blake at CloudOps Inc. is our external auditor contact — cc'd in your first mail if needed) will coordinate SOC 2 disclosures. We will provide a bridge letter within 5 business days of NDA execution.

3) managed-metrics.io observability partner- They would only receive aggregated metrics (latency percentiles, error rates, token counters) and never raw request content or prompt/response text. Any customer who requests extended retention to include traces or sample payloads would require explicit contractual approval and additional data handling controls.

Action items we propose:
- We'll upload an NDA template to the HubSpot record and share SOC 2 bridge letter upon execution.
- I will attach a one‑page data flow diagram for DataLakeOps to the shared drive under the Acme folder after the NDA.
- Marcus will follow up with a short statement for the RFP appendix confirming no planned subprocessor changes in the next 90 days.

If you want to lock a 30-minute call, we have availability Thu 12/10 or Mon 12/14; suggest Thu 12/10 10:00am PT.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
